description: Check if a domain name is available to register. Looks the domain up in the official registry (RDAP) and says whether it is already taken or appears free to buy. Use it to find an available domain for a new business, product, or website name. Price: $0.005 per successful call; failed calls are free. Free to try: a few calls a day without a key.

api_key.description: Your Unstuck API key, if this connection has none. Leave empty to try free tools or to get a key and payment link.

domain.description: The domain name to check, e.g. "mycoolstartup.com".

name: domain_check

available.description: True if no registration was found.

charged_usd.description: Amount charged for this call, USD.

domain.description: The registrable domain that was checked.

title: Check Domain Availability
